C1.rationale: Nearly every hard constraint concerns irreversibility on shared infrastructure or a failed-state push, and each states its reason inline so the model can generalise (why the merge gate is human, why a red pack must not be pushed, why seeding a feature branch is rejected); derivation of names/topics/descriptions is delegated to judgment via a 'how to derive' table rather than prescribed. Only 'Don't fight the hook with quoting tricks either.' is a bare prohibition without a stated why.

C2.rationale: The interface it actually drives — scaffold.py's flags — is declared as a parameters table with alternatives enumerated at the point of declaration and the invalid combination named ('modal variants only; omit for gesture'), so examples illustrate rather than define. Short of exemplary only because the skill's own invocation surface is undeclared: no args or argument-hint in frontmatter, so 'an idea' as free text has no stated shape.

C3.rationale: Generation is deferred to an executable script that runs without being read into context, and two whole downstream pipelines are deferred to separately-loadable sibling skills named inline (comfyui-node-scaffold, comfyui-screenshot-pipeline). It falls short of 5 because the unit ships no supporting file of its own — the rare paths (the branch-protection hook workaround blockquote, the failure-modes table, the Notes section) are all inlined into the single entry point rather than split out.

C6.rationale: Every mechanical step points at an executable or exact artifact rather than prose: generation runs scaffold.py, the green gate is `just check`, rasterization is `just assets`, the infra edits are literal HCL blocks to paste rather than described, and post-apply wiring is verified by two gh commands paired with the exact expected result. The unit is explicit throughout about running the artifact versus reading it (it notes the scaffold prints its own follow-ups and its own finishing-pass audit).
